# Repository Overview

This is a GitHub repository for team **contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa**, part of the **2026 First openvela AI Hardware Developer Contest**. It's a team-exclusive contest workspace that doubles as a code repository and a `repo` manifest for pulling the full openvela project.

## Purpose
Participants submit all contest code, build artifacts, and AI Coding logs here. As the README notes, you work with just this one folder, since the manifest soft-links subdirectories into the openvela build tree.

## Requirements & Steps to Participate

**Step 1 – Pull the full project:**
```
repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa \
  -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa.xml
repo sync -c -j8
```

**Step 2 – Write code only inside your repo directory.** Different deliverable types map to subdirectories via `<linkfile>` entries:

| Deliverable | Your code location | Auto-mapped to |
|---|---|---|
| App | `app/hello_app/` | `packages/demos/contest2026_084_hello_app` |
| Quick App | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_084_hello_quickapp` |
| Board adaptation | `board/contest_board/` | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_084_board` |

Unused directories can be deleted; new works add a matching `<linkfile>`. Production repos (packages/nuttx/vendor) stay unmodified.

**Step 3 – Compile/run** from the openvela workspace root (one level above your repo):
```
./build.sh <board-config-path> [menuconfig|distclean] [-j8]
```
Specific paths depend on your chosen track.

**Step 4 – Submit:**
1. Fork your repo, develop, commit/push, then open a Pull Request you can self-review and merge.
2. Actively export/package AI Coding logs into `logs/` — conversations are only stored locally and not auto-uploaded.
3. For changes to shared repos like nuttx, fork and PR the `dev-ai-contest-2026` branch for committee review.

- `.github/`
- `app/hello_app/`
- `board/contest_board/`
- `logs/`
- `quickapp/hello_quickapp/`
- `.gitignore.example`
- `README.md`
- `contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa.xml`
- `openvela.xml`

Suggested directory convention: `app/ | quickapp/ | board/` for code, `logs/` for AI logs, `README.md` for your work description.

## Required Deliverables
- Contest code and build artifacts
- AI Coding logs in `logs/` (must be committed, not ignored)
- A rewritten README describing your work

## Submission Format & Deadline
- Deadline is "**9 月 20 日**" (September 20). After that, push permissions are revoked but repos remain viewable/clonable.
- All changes go through Pull Requests (branch protection enforced).
- First-time contributors must sign a CLA via the official website; PRs run a `cla/signature` check, and commenting `/check-cla` re-verifies after signing.

## Rules & Templates
- **Naming**: `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>` — 3-digit zero-padded number, lowercase slug team name. Each team gets exactly one repo.
- **README template** should include: work name, intro, track selection, directory structure, run instructions, and AI Coding usage notes.

## Tracks (choose one)
- Quick App / Watch App Innovation
- AI Hardware Product Innovation
- New Hardware Adaptation

Official docs referenced include the Contest Overview, Code Submission Guide, and AI Coding Log Guide.

git bundle create "$BK/vendor-sifli-velapet.bundle" "$SIFLI_BASE"..HEAD

86	def load_redact_rules(log_root: Path) -> list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str]]:

103	def redact_value(value: Any, rules: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str]], counter: list[int]) -> Any:
104	    if isinstance(value, str):
105	        out = value
106	        for pattern, replacement in rules:
107	            new_out, n = pattern.subn(replacement, out)
108	            counter[0] += n
109	            out = new_out
110	        return out
111	    if isinstance(value, list):
112	        return [redact_value(v, rules, counter) for v in value]
113	    if isinstance(value, dict):
114	        return {k: redact_value(v, rules, counter) for k, v in value.items()}
115	    return value

136	def expand_claude_event(raw_event: dict, fallback_ts: str) -> list[dict]:
137	    """Convert one Claude Code transcript event to zero-or-more contest events.
138	
139	    Schema (verified against real ~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl):
140	      - top-level type: user / assistant / system / progress / file-history-snapshot / ...
141	      - real conversation lives in .message
142	      - assistant.message.content is a list of blocks: text / thinking / tool_use
143	      - user.message.content is str (plain input) OR list (containing tool_result blocks)
144	      - tool_result blocks carry tool_use_id pairing back to assistant tool_use
145	    """
146	    out: list[dict] = []
147	    top_type = raw_event.get("type")
148	    ts = raw_event.get("timestamp") or fallback_ts
149	
150	    if top_type in ("progress", "file-history-snapshot", "queue-operation", "permission-mode", "agent-name", "summary", "attachment"):
151	        return out
152	
153	    msg = raw_event.get("message") or {}
154	    role = (msg.get("role") or top_type or "system").lower()
155	    content = msg.get("content")
156	    model = msg.get("model")
157	    usage = msg.get("usage") or {}
158	    tokens_in = usage.get("input_tokens")
159	    tokens_out = usage.get("output_tokens")
160	
161	    common = {"ts": ts}
162	    if model:
163	        common["model"] = model
164	    if isinstance(tokens_in, int):
165	        common["tokens_in"] = tokens_in
166	    if isinstance(tokens_out, int):
167	        common["tokens_out"] = tokens_out
168	
169	    if isinstance(content, str):
170	        if content:
171	            out.append({**common, "role": role, "text": content})
172	        return out
173	
174	    if not isinstance(content, list):
175	        return out
176	
177	    for block in content:
178	        if not isinstance(block, dict):
179	            continue
180	        bt = block.get("type")
181	        if bt in SKIP_BLOCK_TYPES:
182	            continue
183	        if bt == "text":
184	            text = block.get("text", "")
185	            if text:
186	                out.append({**common, "role": role, "text": text})
187	        elif bt == "thinking":
188	            thinking = block.get("thinking") or block.get("text") or ""
189	            if thinking:
190	                out.append({**common, "role": role, "thinking": thinking})
191	        elif bt == "tool_use":
192	            out.append({
193	                **common,
194	                "role": "tool",
195	                "tool_name": block.get("name", "unknown"),
196	                "tool_call_id": block.get("id", f"call_{len(out)}"),
197	                "input": block.get("input"),
198	                "output": None,
199	            })
200	        elif bt == "tool_result":
201	            tool_call_id = block.get("tool_use_id", f"call_{len(out)}")
202	            result_content = block.get("content")
203	            out.append({
204	                **common,
205	                "role": "tool",
206	                "tool_name": "<result>",
207	                "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
208	                "input": None,
209	                "output": result_content,
210	                "is_error": bool(block.get("is_error")),
211	            })
212	        else:
213	            out.append({
214	                **common,
215	                "role": role,
216	                "text": f"[unsupported block type: {bt}]",
217	                "metadata": {"dropped": True, "original_type": bt},
218	            })
219	    return out

223	    seq = start_seq

# 板级适配：SiFli SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD

VelaPet 的应用代码在 `app/velapet/`，但它要跑在 **SiFli SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD** 上，
还需要 `vendor/sifli` 仓库里的板级与芯片侧改动。这些改动属于**公共仓库**
（按《参赛代码提交指南》第三节，公共仓库的改动应 fork 后向 `dev-ai-contest-2026`
提 PR，而不是在专属仓里直接改），所以本目录以**补丁**形式保存，便于评委复现。

## 补丁清单

| 补丁 | 作用 | 是否必需 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0001-boards-sf32lb52_devkit_lcd-enable-VelaPet-and-rework.patch` | 打开 `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_VELAPET` 与 cJSON、LVGL PNG/文件系统；修正触摸 I2C 引脚；接上面板供电轨；把 NOR 数据分区偏移修正为 `0x008A0000`；重做 `/data` 挂载并创建目录；把默认形象图放进 romfs | **必需**（缺了编不出 `velapet`） |
| `0002-chips-sf32lb52-report-the-exact-verify-mismatch-in-t.patch` | NOR 写校验失败时打印首个差异字节与完整 32 字节，便于定位 | 可选（只影响诊断输出） |
| `0003-boards-sf32lb52_devkit_lcd-seed-the-clock-from-the-f.patch` | 上电时把时钟播种为固件编译时间（本板无 RTC 备用电池） | 必需（否则日期是硬件默认值，每日任务/签到不可信） |

补丁涉及的 5 个文件见 `vendor-sifli-changed-files.txt`。

## 基线

补丁基于 openvela 工作区中 `vendor/sifli` 仓库的提交 **`9c079ca`**
（分支 `dev-ai-contest-2026`），即 `repo sync` 后的默认状态。

## 应用方式

先完成根目录 `README.md` 里的 `repo init` / `repo sync`，然后：

```sh
cd <工作区>/vendor/sifli
git am <工作区>/contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa/board/velapet_sf32lb52/0001-*.patch
git am <工作区>/contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa/board/velapet_sf32lb52/0002-*.patch
git am <工作区>/contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa/board/velapet_sf32lb52/0003-*.patch
```

若基线漂移导致 `git am` 冲突，也可以手工照改——补丁很小，逐个文件对照即可。

应用后，`app/velapet/` 已经由 manifest 的 `<linkfile>` 软链到
`packages/demos/contest2026_084_velapet`，apps 的 CMake 自动发现机制会找到它，
**不需要改动 `apps` 仓库的任何文件**。

## 固件

`../firmware/nuttx.bin` 是构建产物，可直接烧录体验。烧录与构建要点见根目录 `README.md`。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drive the official contest adapter core over all local Claude Code transcripts.

This mirrors export-session.py's backfill_claude_code() exactly (same payload,
same env, same working directory), but is invoked directly so we avoid that
function's `bash -c` env lookup, which on this machine resolves to
C:\\Windows\\System32\\bash.exe (the WSL launcher) and mangles $VAR.

Nothing about the produced logs differs: snapshot_core.py does the collection,
redaction, seq numbering and manifest bookkeeping.
"""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

DEMO_REPO = Path(r"D:\velapet-contest\contest2026_084_AAAmengchongpifa")
WORKSPACE = DEMO_REPO.parent
CORE = WORKSPACE / ".claude" / "skills" / "contest-log-collector" / "adapters" / "shared" / "snapshot_core.py"
ENV_FILE = Path.home() / ".claude" / "contest-collector.env"
PROJECTS = Path.home() / ".claude" / "projects"


def load_identity() -> tuple[str, str]:
    team = login = ""
    for line in ENV_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("TEAM_ID="):
            team = line.split("=", 1)[1]
        elif line.startswith("GITHUB_LOGIN="):
            login = line.split("=", 1)[1]
    if not team or not login:
        sys.exit("cannot read TEAM_ID / GITHUB_LOGIN from " + str(ENV_FILE))
    return team, login


def main() -> int:
    team_id, github_login = load_identity()
    print(f"team={team_id} login={github_login}")
    print(f"core={CORE}")
    if not CORE.is_file():
        sys.exit("adapter core not found")

    transcripts = sorted(PROJECTS.glob("*/*.jsonl"))
    print(f"scanning {len(transcripts)} transcript(s) under {PROJECTS}\n")

    child_env = {**os.environ, "TEAM_ID": team_id,
                 "GITHUB_LOGIN": github_login, "CWD": str(DEMO_REPO)}

    captured = 0
    for t in transcripts:
        payload = json.dumps({
            "session_id": t.stem,
            "cwd": str(DEMO_REPO),
            "transcript_path": str(t),
            "hook_event_name": "SessionEnd",
        })
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(CORE), "--tool", "claude-code"],
            input=payload, text=True, capture_output=True,
            env=child_env, cwd=str(DEMO_REPO),
            encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
        )
        rel = t.relative_to(PROJECTS)
        if result.returncode == 0 and "captured" in (result.stderr or ""):
            captured += 1
            line = [l for l in result.stderr.splitlines() if "captured" in l][-1]
            print(f"  OK   {rel}  -> {line.split('->')[-1].strip()}")
        else:
            detail = (result.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()
            print(f"  SKIP {rel}  rc={result.returncode}  {detail[-1] if detail else ''}")
    print(f"\ncaptured {captured}/{len(transcripts)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
